description: Replaceable preview renderer: the one seam through which the editor gets a preview and an HTML export, so the render may run ON THE SERVER while the editor runs in Blazor WebAssembly without Scriban, Mjml.Net or AngleSharp. LocalEmailPreviewRenderer (Engine) is the default; a host that renders elsewhere registers its own. A missing registration is not a silent empty iframe — the editor shows Unavailable with a localized message naming the registration.
